name: Statiq
description: Statiq.Web is a .NET static site generator, a library composed into a small console app, that renders Markdown with front matter through Razor layouts.
notes: Statiq.Web 1.0.0-beta.60 is the latest release (no stable 1.0 exists) and targets netcoreapp3.1; the app targets net10.0 and the image sets DOTNET_ROLL_FORWARD=Major. The app is restored and built in the image; the timed build runs the compiled app with no restore or network. Sitemap generation is disabled and links keep the .html extension.
